reviews.text: Got the subscription but IT DOES NOT WORK. But when it was supposed to work and show me a 7.4M earthquake it didn’t work. Terrible. DO NOT WAIST YOUR MONEY!

reviews.title: Think
reviews.text:
Refuses to allow a ‘user input threshold’ for seismic prone California thus making app useless due to constant alarming.  
I live in Southern California.  
60 mile minimum radius is WAY TOO FAR for a minimum radius here.  
Alerts are constantly going off so I had to turn alerts off.  Please have a user configurable distance so I can have it closer to where I live. 
Put a little thought into this as I purchased the “Pro Version, and it is useless due to the need to turn off notifications!!!📢
